general.game_folder.tip: Folder containing the installed Forza game files used by model and asset import tools.

general.autosave_interval.tip: Minutes between autosave attempts. Set to 0 to disable autosave.

theme.theme.tip: Selects the colors used by application windows and controls.

theme.dark_canvas.tip: Selects the canvas background used with the dark application theme.

theme.light_canvas.tip: Selects the canvas background used with the light application theme.

theme.buffer_background.tip: Selects the background shown behind items in the clipboard buffer.

theme.layer_background.tip: Selects the background used for layer preview thumbnails.

tools.display_anchors.tip: Keeps transform handles visible while a transform drag is in progress.

tools.nudge_small.tip: Distance moved by an arrow key press in Move or Transform.

tools.nudge_big.tip: Distance moved by Shift plus an arrow key in Move or Transform.

tools.toolbar_view.tip: Selects a horizontal toolbar with labels or a compact vertical icon toolbar.

tools.separate_opacity_skew.tip: Shows Opacity and Skew as separate tools instead of transform modes.

editor.guideline_color.tip: Selects the color used to draw canvas guidelines.

editor.visibility_borders.tip: Shows the configured output-resolution boundary on the canvas.

editor.position_limit_border.tip: Shows the position boundary used by the editor.

editor.transformed_previews.tip: Includes layer and group transformations when generating tree previews.

editor.border_resolution.tip: Resolution represented by the canvas visibility border.

editor.livery_texture_scale.tip: Multiplier used for the texture rendered in the 3D livery preview.

editor.value_wheel.tip: Allows the mouse wheel to change numeric property values.

editor.discard_model.tip: Unloads the current car model when another livery project is opened.

editor.load_car_textures.tip: Loads available car material textures for the 3D preview.

system.icon_pack.tip: Selects the application window and .3so project icons after the application restarts.

system.file_association.tip: Registers this executable as the handler for .3so project files for the current Windows user.
